data.title: Super Size Sorter!
data.description: Help sort everyday objects from shortest to longest using your measuring skills!

challenges.instruction: Put the crayon, pencil, and straw in order from shortest to longest!
challenges.hint: Look at the starting line. Which one ends the soonest, and which one goes the furthest?
challenges.narration: Let us practice ordering! Can you line these up from the shortest one to the longest one?

challenges.instruction: Put the fork, toothbrush, and straw in order from shortest to longest!
challenges.hint: Compare them side-by-side. Find the tiniest one first!
challenges.narration: Great job! Here is another set. Let us find the shortest one and build our way up.

challenges.instruction: Put the crayon, toothbrush, and straw in order from shortest to longest!
challenges.hint: Check the ends carefully. Which item is the longest of all three?
challenges.narration: You are doing amazing! Let us try one more ordering challenge.
